lines.en: The Girl and the Ice Cream Truck
lines.zh: 女孩和冰淇淋车

lines.en: A girl sits at her bedroom window, looking down at the street.
lines.zh: 一个女孩坐在卧室窗边，低头看着街道。

lines.en: She is waiting for summer.
lines.zh: 她在等夏天到来。

lines.en: She wants to eat ice cream and go swimming.
lines.zh: 她想吃冰淇淋，想去游泳。

lines.en: She wants picnics and strawberries.
lines.zh: 她想要野餐，想要草莓。

lines.en: She is tired of winter jackets and gloves.
lines.zh: 她受够了冬天的外套和手套。

lines.en: She is tired of grey skies and snow.
lines.zh: 她受够了灰蒙蒙的天空和雪。

lines.en: Her mother says that summer is far away.
lines.zh: 妈妈说夏天还早着呢。

lines.en: Her father says that more snow is coming.
lines.zh: 爸爸说还要下更多的雪。

lines.en: Still, she sits at the window waiting for some sign that summer has arrived.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，她还是坐在窗边，等着夏天到来的信号。

lines.en: Just then, she sees an ice cream truck driving down the street.
lines.zh: 就在这时，她看见一辆冰淇淋车沿街开过来。

lines.en: “An ice cream truck!
lines.zh: “冰淇淋车！

lines.en: That MUST mean it’s summer now!” she squeals.
lines.zh: 那一定说明夏天到了！”她尖叫起来。

lines.en: She runs to her closet and puts on her bathing suit and her summer hat.
lines.zh: 她跑到衣柜前，穿上泳衣，戴上夏天戴的帽子。

lines.en: She runs down the stairs and out the door and… CRUNCH!
lines.zh: 她跑下楼梯、冲出门外，然后……咔嚓！

lines.en: She looks down and sees her bare feet...
lines.zh: 她低头一看，看见自己光着的脚……

lines.en: ….in the icy grass.
lines.zh: ……踩在冰冷的草地上。

lines.en: “But…but… I saw an ice cream truck!” she says, confused.
lines.zh: “可是……可是……我明明看见一辆冰淇淋车！”她困惑地说。

lines.en: She looks up just in time to see the ice cream truck turn the corner ...
lines.zh: 她抬起头，正好看见那辆冰淇淋车拐过街角……

lines.en: ... and pull into the auto repair shop.
lines.zh: ……开进了一家汽车修理店。

lines.en: Moral: Don’t draw a conclusion based on a single observation; one ice cream truck does not make a summer.
lines.zh: 寓意：不要只凭一次观察就下结论——一辆冰淇淋车不代表夏天已经来了。
